_comment: Sample Lakeview dashboard config. BEFORE DEPLOYING: (1) Set sql_warehouse_id in environment.yml. (2) Export a dashboard from your workspace (Dashboards → ⋯ → Export) and save as .lvdash.json. (3) Add: file_path pointing to your exported file (relative to pipelines/ bundle root). Without file_path, Databricks creates an empty dashboard and you fill it in the UI.
